description: This file contains date utility functions for converting date strings into ISO 8601 format and related manipulations.

methods.name: date_MMM_dD_HourYear
methods.description: Converts a date string with month abbreviation, day, hour, and year into ISO 8601 format.

methods.name: date_YY_MM_DD
methods.description: Converts an 8-character date string (YYMMDD) into ISO 8601 format.

methods.name: date_DD_MM_YY
methods.description: Reformats a date string from DDMMYY to ISO 8601 format.

methods.name: date_YY_MMM_DD
methods.description: Converts a date string with year, month abbreviation, and day into ISO 8601 format.
